title: Empire of Silence
author: Christopher Ruocchio
summary: The first of a far-future saga, told as the memoir of Hadrian Marlowe, a man now cursed across the galaxy for burning a sun. He recalls how a young scholar's son was pulled into an empire at war.
readIf: you like long, ornate space opera with a guilty narrator and a feudal, religious empire.
skipIf: you want brisk plotting, since the voice is formal and the story takes its time.

pairings.reason: Shares the mix of feudal houses, a zealous church and an interstellar empire, with a similarly grave tone.
Also a famous man telling his own story in retrospect, with the same ornate, confessional voice.
A literary, many-voiced space epic with a similar sense of ancient dread behind the politics.
